notes: Play knowledge rewritten as executable actions. Every reference is checked against the generated level data by tools/gen_level_nuance.py.

Cradle is the game's finale and its most unusual fight: the target spends most of the level invulnerable and is only damageable in specific states. A bot that simply shoots the boss will empty its ammunition into an enemy that cannot be hurt.

nuance.claim: The control console is destroyed before the confrontation; it is the objective that can be completed calmly and the fight that follows does not allow it.
nuance.because: Objective 0 is a destruction task and objective 1 is the level's terminal confrontation.

nuance.claim: The console sits behind the large machinery rather than in the open, so it is not visible from the walkway it is reached from.
Trevelyan cannot be damaged while he is running; shots land only when he stops, so the fight is about waiting for the right state rather than sustaining fire.
He drops grenades behind him on the lower walkways, so following directly along his path takes damage for nothing; an alternate route reaches the same place safely.
Because the structure is open ironwork, he can be engaged across the gap from a different level rather than chased around it.
An explosive that catches him resolves the fight far faster than sustained gunfire, so a grenade carried into the level is worth more than extra ammunition.
Without explosives the fight is won by strafing to spoil his aim while placing shots high, since body shots take far longer.
The final platform is small and unrailed above a long drop, so movement during the last exchange can kill the player without a shot being fired.
The confrontation travels down through the structure to a platform over the dish, so it is a running fight across several levels rather than one arena.
